title: Octopus Salad

media.caption: Preparing with boiled potatoes and green beans.
Adding the octopus cut into pieces.

healthBenefits.title: Lean Protein Source
healthBenefits.text: Octopus is high in protein and low in fat, supporting muscle repair and satiety.

healthBenefits.title: Rich in Vitamin B12
healthBenefits.text: Octopus provides significant B12, essential for nerve function and red blood cell formation.

healthBenefits.title: Energy from Potatoes
healthBenefits.text: Potatoes offer complex carbohydrates and potassium, supporting sustained energy and heart health.

healthBenefits.title: Fiber-Rich Green Beans
healthBenefits.text: Green beans add dietary fiber and vitamins A and C, aiding digestion and immunity.

healthBenefits.title: Vitamin C Boost
healthBenefits.text: Lemon juice enhances iron absorption and provides antioxidant support.

healthBenefits.title: Heart-Healthy Fats
healthBenefits.text: Extra virgin olive oil supplies monounsaturated fats that promote cardiovascular health.

_ingredientsText:
1 octopus (about 700 g)
• 3 potatoes, diced into cubes
• 300 g of green beans, cleaned
• juice of 1 lemon
• 1 clove of garlic, chopped or crushed
• 10 mint leaves, chopped
• 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil
• salt
_preparationText:
1. polpo prima della preparazione
2.pulizia della testa 
3.eliminazione degli occhi
4.rimozione della pelle
5.bollitura in acqua bollente
6.preparazione con patate lesse e fagiolini
7.aggiunta del polpo tagliato in pezzi
8.aggiunta di buccia di limone tritata
